Flying Fijians intensify preparations ahead of Japan clash

item.content:encoded:
The FIJI Water Flying Fijians are stepping up their preparations for their upcoming challenge against Japan in the Pacific Nations Cup final, with the team focused on getting their plans right both on and off the field.

Speaking from the Urayasu D-Rocks Training Fields, Assistant Coach Ifereimi Rawaqa says the team has completed its morning clarity session and is preparing for a big training session this afternoon.

Rawaqa says the players are sticking to their plans and making sure they look after themselves first as they continue their preparations.

The focus now is on putting in the hard work while ensuring the players are physically and mentally ready for the challenge ahead.

The Flying Fijians are continuing to build towards their match in Japan, with the coaching staff and players working together to ensure they are well prepared.

The team says the journey continues with the support of the nation.

Flying Fijians set for Japan clash at 10.05pm this Saturday.

item.title: Three titles secured under Ba FC president Praneel Dayal’s leadership
item.description: Ba Football Club has secured three major domestic titles under president Praneel Dayal in his first year at the helm of the Ba Football Association. The Men in Black completed the treble after winning the 2026 Battle of the Giants, BiC Fiji FACT and Extra Premier League titles.
item.content:encoded:
Ba Football Club has secured three major domestic titles under president Praneel Dayal in his first year at the helm of the Ba Football Association.

The Men in Black completed the treble after winning the 2026 Battle of the Giants, BiC Fiji FACT and Extra Premier League titles.

Ba will now turn its attention to the FMF Inter-District Championship, which starts on 6 October, as it looks to add another major title to its 2026 campaign.

The Men in Black lost the IDC final to Rewa last year.

item.title: Derenalagi, Vakatawa, Valetini, Basiyalo and Rounds re-signs with Fijian Drua for 2027 season
FIFA President congratulates Ba FA on historic treble season
item.description: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has congratulated Ba Football Association on being crowned Battle of the Giants champions of Fiji. Infantino congratulated Ba FA and its players and officials on their achievement saying Ba’s consistent efforts and results throughout the season have paid off with the important title.
item.content:encoded:
FIFA President Gianni Infantino has congratulated Ba Football Association on being crowned Battle of the Giants champions of Fiji.

Infantino congratulated Ba FA and its players and officials on their achievement saying Ba’s consistent efforts and results throughout the season have paid off with the important title.

He congratulated every member of the team and club for the achievement.

Infantino also thanked the Fiji Football Association for its continued support, work and dedication towards the development of football in Fiji.

Ba has enjoyed a successful 2026 season, winning the Extra Premier League, BiC Fiji FACT and Battle of the Giants titles.

They now prepare for the Inter District Championship which will be from 6th to 14th October at the HFC Bank Stadium.

item.title: Manchester United crash out after 3-2 loss to Brighton
item.description: Manchester United suffered a painful Carabao Cup exit after throwing away a two-goal lead to lose 3-2 to Brighton at Old Trafford. In other results, Everton beat Wolverhampton Wanderers 1-0, Aston Villa defeated Coventry City 3-1, and Fleetwood Town secured a 1-0 win over Sheffield United.

item.title: Nadi and Nadroga set for Skipper Cup showdown
item.description: The battle of the West takes centre stage in the Skipper Cup this week, with table-toppers Nadi set to face Nadroga at King Charles Park in Nadi. The former Skipper Cup champions will be looking to hand Nadi their first defeat of the season.
item.content:encoded:
The battle of the West takes centre stage in the Skipper Cup this week, with table-toppers Nadi set to face Nadroga at King Charles Park in Nadi.

The former Skipper Cup champions will be looking to hand Nadi their first defeat of the season.

In other matches, Ba will host Naitasiri at the 4R Stadium in Ba, while Tailevu will face Lautoka at Ratu Cakobau Park in Nausori.

Kadavu will play Taveuni on the Garden Island at Taveuni, while Suva will face Malolo at the Suva Grammar School Ground.

Rewa will take on Navosa at the Burebasaga Grounds in Rewa.

The Under-20 fixtures will start at 1pm, with the same fixtures being played at the same grounds.
